title: TechScript
tagline: A modern, human-readable programming language and compiler toolchain built from scratch in Rust.
description: TechScript is an open-source programming language designed to make source code read like clear, structured English while retaining systems-level performance. The ecosystem includes a native Rust compiler, lexer, recursive-descent parser, strict AST representation, stack-based bytecode virtual machine, package manager, and language server.
problem: Modern programming languages often enforce heavy punctuation syntax that obscures procedural intent, while high-level scripting languages lack deterministic native toolchains and integrated compilation pipelines.
solution: Engineered a complete 2.0 language specification and compiler driver ('tsc') in Rust using Cargo workspaces. Features keyword-delimited blocks (do/when/loop/end), strict type checking, intermediate bytecode representation, and a stack-based VM runtime.
features: Custom Lexer & Tokenizer with zero-copy source slice spans
Recursive descent parser generating validated Abstract Syntax Trees (AST)
Stack-based Bytecode Virtual Machine with NaN-boxed value representations
Standard library modules for I/O, strings, math, HTTP, and data structures
Unified 'tsc' command-line driver supporting run, build, check, test, format, and lint
Interactive in-browser WebAssembly execution playground
architecture: Source (.txs) → Lexer (Tokens) → Parser (AST) → Semantic Analyzer → IR Lowering → Bytecode Compiler / LLVM Backend → VM Runtime / Native Binary
challenges: Implementing efficient stack frames and lexical scope resolution in a custom Rust VM
Balancing plain-English readability with unambiguous grammar rules
Optimizing memory allocation through AST node arena pools and zero-copy string slicing
optimizations: Zero-copy string tokenization across source code buffer spans
Bytecode instruction folding for constant arithmetic expressions
Arena-allocated syntax tree nodes to reduce heap allocation churn

roadmap.title: Core Rust Lexer, Parser & Cargo Workspace Setup
TechScript 2.0 AST Generator & Stack Bytecode VM Runtime
LLVM Native IR Emitter & Language Server Protocol (LSP)

title: Satvora AI
tagline: AI health coach, multimodal food photo scanner & calorie tracker for Android.
description: Satvora AI is an Android application that combines multimodal computer vision with a comprehensive nutritional taxonomy designed specifically for Indian dietary diversity. It lets users scan meals, track macros, and receive evidence-informed dietary dialogue while keeping personal journal data stored locally on-device.
problem: Most calorie tracking applications rely on Western-centric food databases, require tedious manual gram typing, and store sensitive personal biometrics on third-party servers.
solution: Built an Android-native application that leverages camera-based multimodal meal analysis, offline-first local SQLite/Room data architecture, and multi-lingual Indian dietary taxonomy.
features: Multimodal food photo scanning with automatic ingredient and portion estimation
Comprehensive regional Indian dish catalog supporting 14 Indian languages
Offline-first local storage architecture ensuring personal nutrition logs remain on-device
Barcode lookup for packaged consumer food products
Evidence-informed dietary feedback with zero unsupported medical claims
architecture: Camera Scanner → Multimodal Vision Parser → Food Taxonomy Mapper → Local Room Database → Reactive Compose UI
challenges: Distinguishing complex multi-ingredient regional Indian dishes with diverse gravies
Guaranteeing zero latency on low-end Android hardware via asynchronous background processing
Enforcing strict privacy boundaries so health logs are not uploaded needlessly
optimizations: Local Room database indexing for instant sub-millisecond food searches
Client-side image normalization and compression prior to model inference
Asynchronous background image pre-processing with Kotlin Coroutines

roadmap.title: Multimodal Food Scanner & Core Macro Calculation
Regional Indian Dietary Database & Multi-Language Support
Closed Testing Track on Google Play with Active Tester Feedback

title: KinotiX
tagline: Interactive 4K live & 3D parallax wallpaper engine published on Google Play.
description: KinotiX is an Android wallpaper engine published on the Google Play Store (com.kinotix.app). It provides dynamic 3D gyroscope parallax depth, interactive touch-reactive fluid simulations, AMOLED deep-black galleries, and transparent live camera backgrounds.
problem: Live wallpaper applications on mobile devices frequently cause severe battery drain, frame drops, and lack physical depth responsiveness.
solution: Built a custom OpenGL ES rendering engine in Kotlin with strict lifecycle hooks that completely suspends render loops when the device is locked or occluded.
features: Hardware gyroscope and accelerometer-driven multi-plane parallax depth
Touch-reactive Eulerian fluid simulation with ripples and particle physics
AMOLED true-black dark themes to conserve OLED display battery life
Live transparent camera feed mode rendering through wallpaper surface
Automated battery saver mode suspending GPU calls when screen is off
architecture: Hardware Sensor Events → Physics Velocity Field → OpenGL ES Shader Pipeline → SurfaceHolder Canvas
challenges: Maintaining smooth 60–120Hz display refresh rates while executing fluid physics shaders
Calibrating multi-axis sensor smoothing to avoid jitter during hand tremors
optimizations: Low-overhead native OpenGL shader uniforms caching
Dynamic framerate throttling during static periods
Zero background execution when device display is inactive

roadmap.title: OpenGL ES Gyro Parallax Core & WallpaperService Pipeline
Touch Fluid Simulation & AMOLED Theme Library
Custom User Video Import & 3D Layer Editor

title: NovOS
tagline: A futuristic web-based desktop operating system with neomorphic window management.
description: NovOS is a complete web-based operating system providing a reactive desktop interface, draggable multi-window manager, POSIX virtual file system over IndexedDB, taskbar launcher, and built-in system utilities engineered in React and TypeScript.
problem: Standard web portfolios feel flat, static, and fail to demonstrate complex multi-entity state management, windowing systems, and filesystem architectures.
solution: Engineered a custom windowing engine with draggable floating viewports, virtual file system with persistent storage, theme customization, and an integrated suite of desktop applications.
features: Reactive window manager with maximize, minimize, snap, and z-index depth management
Persistent virtual file system using browser IndexedDB for real file operations
Taskbar app launcher, notification tray, and dynamic system clock
Built-in terminal emulator with custom shell commands and file manipulation utilities
architecture: React Desktop Shell → Window Focus Engine → IndexedDB VFS Layer → Zustand State Stores → Viewport Render
challenges: Managing focus states and dynamic z-index layers across multiple concurrent windows
Ensuring 60fps window dragging and resizing performance with complex child layouts
optimizations: Window state memoization preventing cascading re-renders during drags
CSS transform GPU acceleration for window coordinates
Lazy loading application sub-modules on demand

roadmap.title: IndexedDB Virtual File System & File Previews

title: Vortyx
tagline: Modern Android media downloader and download manager built with Kotlin & Jetpack Compose.
description: Vortyx is a high-performance Android media downloader and transfer manager built with modern Kotlin and Jetpack Compose. It provides multi-threaded chunked downloads, pause/resume capability, and smart directory organization.

solution: Engineered a lightweight, ad-free Android utility with Material 3 guidelines, Jetpack WorkManager background task management, and asynchronous I/O.
features: Material 3 dynamic theming interface with smooth Compose animations
Resumable multi-threaded chunked file downloads
Automated categorization into Video, Audio, Image, and Document directories
Background worker tasks utilizing Android Jetpack WorkManager
architecture: Compose UI → ViewModel StateFlow → WorkManager Dispatcher → OkHttp Network Engine → Scoped Storage
challenges: Managing reliable background download transfers across aggressive Android OEM battery optimizations
optimizations: Non-blocking asynchronous network polling and I/O buffer streaming
